name: Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings, Inc.
summary: Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings, Inc. engages in the purchase and sale of semiconductors and electronic components in Japan. The company operates through Device Business and Solution Business segments. It also offers embedded devices and software, server network, power supply and systems, security, video and printing, equipment installation and kitting services, and contract development, as well as manufactures DX/automation support; and IT products and solutions. Ryoyo Ryosan Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Chiyoda, Japan.
